notes.title: Update 1.4.0
notes.content:
There's no changes to the code and assets of the game this time. After watching a bunch of streamers play [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2677680/Goblin_and_Coins_II_The_Lost_Recipes/]The Lost Recipes[/url], I've decided to add (more) bean soup cauldrons to larger, exploration-focused levels, in the base game too. 

It's not going to turn it into an easy game, but should be more welcoming to the players who are after the certain achievements, while still being difficult to master.

tags.feature: I've decided to add (more) bean soup cauldrons to larger, exploration-focused levels, in the base game too.

notes.title: The Lost Recipes is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
The wait is finally over, [b]The Lost Recipes is OUT NOW[/b] and can be purchased on Steam. Please note that, if you already own the previous two games, you can save on top of the -20% launch discount by purchasing the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/24672/Goblin_and_Coins_collection/]complete the set bundle[/url]. 

[b]What awaits you?[/b]

[list]
[*]     Familiar platforming mechanics, traps and enemies, but improved! 
[*]     25 handcrafted levels
[*]     world 1 very easy, worlds 2 and 3 easy/medium, worlds 4-5 a bit challenging  
[*]     Unlimited continues / level restarts 
[*]     No boss fights, just platforming fun!  
[*]     Double-jump available from the very start of the game 
[*]     5 brand new recipes to unlock, prepare (baking), and post your artwork to the game hub 
[*]    English and Serbian language (with Brazilian Portuguese coming soon and more to potentially come later)
[*]   Gamepad support, keyboard re-binding  
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2677680/Goblin_and_Coins_II_The_Lost_Recipes/ 

[i]Please note - if you're using GNU/Linux and your default Proton doesn't work, try switching to version 9.0.2. [/i]

tags.feature: - Double-jump available from the very start of the game
- 5 brand new recipes to unlock, prepare (baking), and post your artwork to the game hub
- English and Serbian language (with Brazilian Portuguese coming soon and more to potentially come later)
- Gamepad support, keyboard re-binding

notes.title: The Lost Recipes will release on August 28th
notes.content:
Hello little goblins,
Let's head back into adventuring and numismatics! The Lost Recipes, a much easier stand-alone expansion for the Goblin and Coins II, will release on August 28th on Steam.

[b]What can you expect?[/b]

[list]
[*]         25 handcrafted levels (that get a bit challenging close to the end, but are a walk in the park compared to the most of GnC2 maze-like levels)
[*]         Familiar mechanics, traps and enemies - but improved!
[*]         Unlimited continues / level restarts
[*]         No boss fights, just platforming
[*]         Double-jump available from the very start of the game
[*]         5 brand new recipes to unlock, prepare, and post your artwork to the game hub
[*]         Locked chests, shortcut portals and secret areas 
[*]         Affordable price 
[*]         Doesn't require you to play any previous game 
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2677680/Goblin_and_Coins_II_The_Lost_Recipes/

notes.title: Update 1.2.3
notes.content:
Nothing really changed in this new build compared to the previous one in the means of levels, enemies, gameplay... The only thing is that I've increased the number of continues available in order to motivate the players who don't understand the idea of continues and the underworld and might be scared by the shrinking numbers, and reward those who manage to escape it. So, from now on...

[list]
[*] New game with an "easier start" ON (default) sets you with 30* continues instead of 20.
[*] New game with an "easier start" OFF sets you with 20* continues instead of 15.
[*] Escaping the underworld adds 20 new continues instead of 15. 
[/list]

*) Sadly, this requires a new game to be started, existing saves won't be changed automatically.

tags.balance_change: [*] New game with an "easier start" ON (default) sets you with 30* continues instead of 20.
[*] New game with an "easier start" OFF sets you with 20* continues instead of 15.
[*] Escaping the underworld adds 20 new continues instead of 15.

notes.content:
I'm sorry you had to wait, but the gamepad input on Linux/SteamOS should now be working the same way it does on Windows. Even the users of SteamDeck should not have to use Keyboard emulation (WASD) anymore. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ck4Qncz.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Re-wrote the gamepad input from scratch. 
[/list]
Windows already worked fine; 
Linux/SteamOS users should be able to notice a gamepad icon in the lower-left corner when starting the game instead of keyboard icon, use the gamepad in the menus and the game, and also get gamepad-adjusted hints during the gameplay instead of kb-only ones, like this: 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YzyjpBr.png[/img]

notes.title: Try the DEMO in the NEXT fest
notes.content:
Goblin and Coins II will participate in the NEXT FEST June '22 with a DEMO for you to try out and hopefully have fun. 

[u]What to expect in the DEMO:[/u]
[list]
[*] Only English and Serbian language. More to come in the full release. 
[*] Only the Windows build available for now, Linux/SteamDeck dedicated build coming later (you can try and use Proton though). 
[*] All settings and options available, be sure to tune it to your liking before playing. 
[*] Available levels: Midnight raid, Sunny beach, Fisherman's village, Dark mines, Downhill, Cpt. Greenbeard boss fight, Snowy pass, Ice caves (+ the underground, a special level you only get to see after you lose all lives/continues). These are the initial levels and are on the easy side. 
[*] Quarter of the world map, including store/trader (ingame coins exchanged for upgrades, no mtx!)
[*] Upgrade 2 (double jump) is purchasable for free (available sum will go into debt. I recommend getting the 4th life first, so you can have both)
[*] Upgrade 4 (shrinky in a blinky) works automatically without a purchase (will cost 200 coins later)
[/list]

If you have any comments and want to provide feedback after playing the DEMO you can [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/694990/discussions/0/3382779373367445926/]visit the forums and write your thoughts there[/url] (you can also press F1 in game to jump there instantly).

https://youtu.be/6kZ1QU4gfsk
